summary: Frontend-only regression test for the header dot alignment CSS fix in ARCHAUDIT. Verified that the accent dot (first child span) inside each of the three column headers (column-architect, column-chaos, column-hardened) aligns with the FIRST line of the wrapped title, not floating between two lines. Also verified core EXECUTE AUDIT flow still populates all three columns.
test_methodology: Loaded app via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at multiple viewport widths (1180, 1024, 900, 820, 768). At width=820 the CHAOS_INJECTION title wraps to 2 lines (titleH=32, lineHeight=16). Measured dotCenter - firstLineCenter via JS getBoundingClientRect. Result across all widths and wrapped states: diff = -1px (dot center is 1px above the first-line's vertical center) — this confirms top-alignment to the first title line. If the dot were mis-centered between two wrapped lines, diff would be ~+8px.

issues: Verdict stamp overlay (STRUCTURAL SOUND / FRACTURED / HARDENED) overlaps and clips the ASCII diagram top line, making both hard to read. Cosmetic — pre-existing and outside the scope of this fix.

dot_alignment_measurements.unit: pixels (dotCenter - firstLineCenter). ~0 = aligned to first line; ~+8 would indicate misaligned (centered between two lines).

verification_evidence.regression_execute_audit: All three columns reached loaded state (column-architect-loaded, column-chaos-loaded, column-hardened-loaded) after clicking execute-audit-button. COPY buttons and latency badges rendered without clipping the titles.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix in StageColumn header (App.tsx:103-108) is correct: items-start on the flex container + mt-[3px] on the 8x8 dot yields exact vertical alignment with the first title line, verified across wrapped and non-wrapped states.
Minor unrelated: verdict stamp overlays clip the ASCII diagram behind them (cosmetic, pre-existing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header dot alignment bug fix verified at 820px viewport where CHAOS_INJECTION wraps to two lines. Measurement helper: compare (dotCenter - firstLineCenter) — should be ~0 for correctly aligned first-line dot.
